1.
Mr. Ankur Sharma, learned counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By the instant C482 application, the present applicants are challenging the proceeding of Complaint Case No.7445 of 2022, wherein the present applicant has been summoned for the offence punishable under Sections 406 and 120-B IPC, Pooja Mamgai versus Arun Rayal and others,
pending in the Court of learned 1st Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun.

entities.text: Pooja Mamgai versus Arun Rayal and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicant No.1 married with respondent no.3- complainant on 14.04.2021.
Out of this wedlock, a child was born, who is living with respondent no.3.
Earlier, the respondent no.3 lodged an FIR bearing FIR No.300 of 2023 for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 323 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 IPC.
Thereafter, a notice was given to the applicant on 21.10.2022 for returning the articles which were given as dowry at the time of marriage and the response has been given by the applicant.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the applicant no.1 wants to live with the respondent no.3- complainant-wife and there is chance of amicable settlement and efforts are going on for their amicable settlement.
6. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder for the State submits that prima facie, the allegations appears to be matrimonial in nature and efforts should be made for their amicable settlement.

7. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned State Counsel accepts notice on behalf of respondent nos.1 and 2.
8.
Issue notice to respondent no.3.
9. Learned counsel for the applicant shall take steps to serve respondent no.3 within three days.

sentences.text: 10. Put up this matter on 26.06.2024.
On that day the applicant no.1 and respondent no.3 shall remain present in the Court.
11. It is made clear that the respondent no.2 shall appear either with her father or brother on the date fixed.

12. In the meantime, further proceeding of Complaint Case No.7445 of 2022, wherein the present applicant has been summoned for the offence punishable under Sections 406 and 120-B IPC, Pooja Mamgai versus Arun Rayal and others, pending in the Court of learned 1st Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun shall remain stayed.
